architecture_decisions: Full-screen Development Studio for autonomous Parallax application build management.
work_items: Create Development Studio for autonomous Parallax application build management.
validations: Ensure Development Studio provides exact Project/Run/Work Specification identity, bounded task/recovery/validation/evaluation/delivery/economic evidence, and only the controls advertised by the server.
AC-01: validate protected requirement — Studio displays canonical Project/Run/Work Specification/revision/state identity from W7-S2 and does not synthesize replacements.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — The main canvas makes current task/stage flow and progress legible without requiring operator management of individual agents or inventing dependencies.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Current bounded artifact/progress, validation/evaluation and delivery/Preview evidence is presented in context and binds the exact projected run/source identity available from W7-S2.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — Checkpoint/recovery/reassignment/generation state is legible when present and is not fabricated from client transient state.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — Failed protected deterministic validation is visually explicit and cannot be masked by positive evaluation/routing/Preview evidence.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — Preview/PR/source delivery evidence is clearly non-production; REVIEW/HUMAN_REQUIRED is an explicit handoff and the UI offers no completion/deploy shortcut.
AC-07: validate protected requirement — Only current W7-S2 advertised controls are enabled and every request binds Project/Run/expected revision/state/request identity without extra authority fields.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Stale, denied, unauthorized and unsupported control outcomes do not optimistically mutate the UI; the Studio refreshes canonical projection and explains the bounded failure.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Observed, estimated and unknown economics retain their state/provenance semantics; unknown is never rendered as zero and estimated is not represented as observed.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Client code/tests prove credentials, raw provider payloads, prompts, hidden reasoning, source bytes/patches and unrestricted logs are not requested or rendered.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Desktop and narrow/mobile layouts preserve critical identity/state/validation/REVIEW information, keyboard access, semantic relationships, focus, contrast and reduced-motion behavior.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Studio grants no new source acceptance, lifecycle transition, recovery ownership, provider/tool administration, arbitrary command/network, merge/deploy or REVIEW completion authority.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — Before integration, S3 commits authentic DSPy evidence for `P2-V0.20.3`, reconciles to the latest accepted Wave 7 integration SHA, passes protected spec validation, client type/state/export checks, browser/Skia acceptance and applicable cumulative gates, then stops `READY FOR INTEGRATION` for Control Tower expected-head merge.

AC-14: validate protected requirement — A focused client acceptance test proves that explicit Work Specification approval followed by activation into `PLAN` (or another autonomous active stage) immediately calls the existing bounded autonomous endpoint with the exact returned revision and a deterministic operation identity. A reload with an already-active unpaused run performs one bounded continuation attempt from freshly fetched server state. Tests also prove `PAUSED`, `FAILED`, `REVIEW`, `SPEC_AMENDMENT`, `CANCELLED` and `COMPLETE` do not auto-continue, and narrow/mobile presentation cannot leave a valid active run permanently parked at `PLAN` solely because no desktop-only continuation control exists.
risks: Mitigate risk by ensuring Development Studio only consumes W7-S2 projection/control API, grants no new source acceptance, lifecycle transition, recovery ownership, provider/tool administration, arbitrary command/network access, and never displays hidden reasoning/private scratchpad, raw prompts.

critique: The single most material implementation risk or omission in the approved software specification is the lack of explicit Work Specification approval for the autonomous Development Studio, which may lead to a situation where the Studio is activated without the operator's explicit intent to begin the bounded protected run.
